cmd:skills.location: src/settings.ts, src/actions/settings-run.ts, src/skills.ts, src/skills-model.ts, src/actions/promptcreator-run.ts, src-tauri/src/input.rs
cmd:skills.note: :skills opens Settings at Claude Skills (the settings slice) and the skills list on top (afterAction) over ListSkills user:true (hub #3062): j/k move, Enter previews SKILL.md (GetSkill), R reload; the Settings row opens the same list (its e and d open it too). e enables or disables the selected skill through rsid SetSkillEnabled and d deletes it through DeleteSkill (#97): the TUI's rename to or from <name>.disabled and its removal of the skill directory, run by rsid with the shared rsi_common::input_assets functions the TUI's e/d call. Both frontends now ask for a second d (within 2 s) before deleting, since the removal is permanent (#131): the desktop and the TUI show a 'press d again' hint and the first press deletes nothing. Both show the TUI's notices

key:<Space>gP.note: opens (or closes) the prompt creator over the daemon's prompt-file RPCs (hub #3040: ListPromptFiles, GetPromptFile, PutPromptFile, DeletePromptFile); the desktop never touches ~/.rsi/prompts itself

module:ui/prompt_creator.rs.note: list cards (name, first line, age, size) and the split editor; see overlay:prompt-creator-space-gp

overlay:prompt-creator-space-gp.note: j/k, Enter opens the editor, Ctrl+N new (create_only; n is a desktop alias since Ctrl-N can be a menu accelerator), d moves the prompt to the daemon's trash and names the trash path, m model picker (the badge, display only as in the TUI), q/Esc close; editor: Ctrl+S saves (atomic put), Enter inserts a line break, Esc or q (normal mode) returns to the list; a dirty editor asks for a second close before it discards
